Where can I buy Waddat?
You can buy Waddat in person at our store and selected stockists. Visit our Where to Buy section for current locations.
Can I order Waddat online?
We're not taking online orders at the moment. You can explore the drinks here, then visit our store or a participating stockist to buy them.
Which drinks are available?
Our range includes Sorrel, Soursop Sea Moss, Ginger, Lemonade, and Pineapple Sea Moss. Availability may vary by location.
Are Waddat drinks suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets?
Yes. All Waddat drinks are suitable for vegans and vegetarians.
How should I store Waddat drinks?
Keep them chilled! Refrigeration helps maintain their freshness and authentic flavor profile over time.
